## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Esoteric scripture by **Amoghavajra** ([不空](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%8D%E7%A9%BA)) integrating the Pure Land **nine-grades-of-rebirth** doctrine (*jiǔpǐn wǎngshēng* 九品往生 — the Pure Land doctrine that rebirth in *Sukhāvatī* takes nine forms graded by the practitioner's level of attainment) with the Esoteric *samādhi*-*dhāraṇī* practice. The text is one of Amoghavajra's principal contributions to the **Esoteric-Pure Land synthesis**.

**Abstract**

The text presents a comprehensive Esoteric framework for Pure Land rebirth practice, establishing how each of the nine grades of rebirth corresponds to specific *samādhi*-attainments and *dhāraṇī*-recitations. The synthesis integrates the popular Pure Land devotional cult — based on the nine-grades doctrine of the *Guān Wúliàngshòu fó jīng* 觀無量壽佛經 ([KR6f0071](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0071), T12n0365) — with the Esoteric *Vajradhātu* framework of the Lotus-family.

The composition dates from Amoghavajra's mature Cháng'ān period (746–774).
